hypotheses.name: Hashish packets vs other drugs
hypotheses.basis: Hashish (cannabis resin) packets are typically more radiolucent than cocaine/heroin due to lower density; however, when tightly wrapped in plastic/vinyl, they can appear moderately dense. The observed moderate density and ovoid shape align best with hashish packets in clinical case reports, whereas cocaine/heroin packets often show higher density or heterogeneous appearance if adulterated.
